name: FUSION_STATE
hypothesis: The already-trained fusion has complementary hidden information absent from separately trained refiners; expose it to an RGB-anchored readout
input: Existing phase-unit R/E 340 plus F_TRUE combine hidden160/raw_location/emitted_phase; 502 total
control: Both arms retain R/E predictive states; ZERO_FUSED zeros only the 162 additional fusion coordinates. This tests incremental fused representation, not event absence.
normalization: Existing five phase coordinates per modality /0.03; both F_TRUE phase coordinates /0.03; no V-fit normalization
output: Original raw RGB anchor +0.03 unrestricted correction; native RGB widths plus correction; zero final layer exactly reproduces R_CTX
optimizer: Same H mass, fusion_loss, AdamW, schedule, sampler, batch128, seed7, 2500 updates
gates: Original 2% bucket gates and paired FUSED minus ZERO_FUSED group bootstrap; retain 4% sensitivity separately
stages: F_TRUE and E/R contexts were already supervised on H; another supervised H stage, not OOF
